---
title: "Working title of the article"
description: "One or two sentences, about 150 characters. Shown on the article card, in Google results and in link previews."
date: {{date}}
categories: [Topic]
# Optional cover image: put the file in this folder. It is used on the article card
# and as the social-share image. About 1200 x 630 px works best.
# image: cover.png
# image-alt: "Describe the image for screen readers"
featured: false       # true = also appear under "Featured Articles" on the homepage
draft: true           # DELETE THIS LINE TO PUBLISH. While it is here the article
                      # shows in `quarto preview` but is left out of the built site.
# toc: true           # add a table of contents (useful for long articles)
---

HOW TO USE THIS TEMPLATE

STYLE NOTES
  - The site font has one weight, so **bold** does nothing. Use headings, lists and

::: {.lead}
An opening paragraph of one to three sentences that says what this article is about
and why it matters.
:::

## Extract from LinkedIn

Use this box when an article starts from, or quotes, one of your LinkedIn posts.

::: {.linkedin-post}
[Shared on LinkedIn · Month YYYY]{.post-source}

Paste the text of the post here. Keep line breaks as blank lines between paragraphs.

[View the original post on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/your-post-url)
:::

## A section heading

Write normally. Link to a source like [this](https://example.com). Use lists for
key points:

- First point.
- Second point.
- Third point.

::: {.callout-note title="Key takeaways"}
Use a callout for the one to three points a reader should remember.
:::

> A quotation or pull-quote is written like this.
